name: Silicon dioxide
what_it_is: A very fine white powder. It is the same material as sand and quartz, ground extremely small.
why_its_added: Keeps powders loose and free-flowing, so salt and spice mixes do not set into lumps.

india.note: Maximum level depends on the food. Examples below.

eu.note: Re‐evaluation of silicon dioxide (E 551) as a food additive in foods for infants below 16 weeks of age and follow‐up of its re‐evaluation as a food additive for uses in foods for all population groups

usa.note: Permitted as a food additive, subject to the conditions in this section (21 CFR 172.480)

safe_daily_limit.no_number_means: EFSA has not set a number for this one. That can mean it is considered safe enough not to need a limit, or that the evidence was not sufficient to set one. The opinion itself says which.

means: No single-serving limit has been found for this substance. That is not the same as there being no risk from one large serving - it means nobody has published a number.

people_reports.rule: Reports are shown as reports. We count them. We never turn them into a health claim, and we never let them change the sourced facts above.

india_limits.food_category: Salt (including edible common salt, iron fortified salt, iodized salt)*
